$comment: Workspace file download, contract 1.10.0 (ADR 0028). Deliberately the same two fields as filesystem-read: a download names a file and nothing else. There is no `encoding`, `range`, `offset`, `length`, `disposition` or `mime` field, and additionalProperties is false - the caller cannot ask for part of a file, cannot ask for it transcoded, and cannot influence how the browser will treat the bytes. A separate type from filesystem.read rather than a flag on it, because the two answer different questions under different policies: read is a bounded text preview that refuses binary, download is the exact bytes and refuses nothing for being binary.

path.$comment: Workspace-relative. Same shared pattern as filesystem-read.path: no absolute path, no ~, no .. segment, no control character.
